Wrangler Air in the F-100×68×50 box, schematic A

AliExpress IP65 box, black base 36 mm and clear lid 14 mm (sizes from the seller drawing, check on the real box). DinMeter in one end wall, two M12 cable glands in the other. Relay flat on the floor, Grove 5 cm from PORT.B; the 2 m Grove from PORT.A leaves through the right gland to the sensor, together with the violet ARB wire. Left gland: black GND, red +12 V to the DinMeter and red +12 V to relay COM (silicone 20 AWG). No ADC. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
